description: Learn how websites work, find vulnerabilities, and earn your first bounty.

phases.title: Phase 1: Foundations (Weeks 1–4)
items: Networking Basics — IP, HTTP, DNS (TryHackMe: Pre-Security)
How the Web Works — PortSwigger Web Security Academy (Intro)
Build 1 mini project: A simple port scanner in Python

phases.title: Phase 2: Core Web Security (Weeks 5–8)
items: OWASP Top 10 — PortSwigger Labs (SQLi, XSS, IDOR)
Burp Suite Basics — Watch 3 tutorials, then practice on labs
Learn HTTP requests & responses deeply — use browser DevTools daily
Build 1 project: A basic vulnerability report on a lab target

phases.title: Phase 3: Bug Bounty Entry (Weeks 9–12)
items: Recon Basics — subfinder, httpx, ffuf (learn one at a time)
Pick 1 VDP program with wide scope — start testing legally
Document your findings — even duplicates teach you something
